EUR 22.8m capex incurred in FY2025. SGD 85m fixed rate green notes issued May 2025 to partly finance repositioning.
Former Berlin Campus tenant DRV filed a EUR 8.4m legal claim in H1 2025 contesting dilapidation costs. No provision recorded as at 31 Dec 2025. Court filing still pending.

Berlin Campus valuation assumes (i) lease finalisation with major prospective office tenant (ii) refurbishment cost as provided by Manager (iii) no construction cost/risk adjustment. These are special assumptions per the valuer.

property_gross_revenue.basis: Property cards disclose 'Gross Rental Income' which is a mix of pure rental income and (for German/Spanish offices) includes service charges in the headline GRI figure. Per-property card GRI sums to EUR 41,728k. Portfolio overview disclosures sum to EUR 41.7m (Germany overview €17.8m + Spain portfolio overview €7.5m + Decathlon portfolio p.63 €9.2m + B&M portfolio p.79 €7.2m = €41.7m). These agree within 0.07% (pure rounding). Performance.gross_revenue = EUR 50,434k is TOTAL gross revenue including service charge income (EUR 8,412k), carpark income (EUR 2,626k), and other income (EUR 277k). The card GRI figures represent rental income plus service-charge elements rolled into the headline GRI, which is a different basis from Note 3.2 rental income (EUR 39,119k). The reconciliation here is at the card GRI granularity.
